messages.subject: Global talent introduction | Senior Thailand and ASEAN industrial leadership
messages.body:
Dear RGF HR Agent Thailand Team,

I am introducing my profile for senior Thailand and ASEAN opportunities where international industrial experience and country stakeholder leadership are required.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ year career spans multinational mining, financial services and commercial operations. My current responsibilities include government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive advisory.

My strongest fit is with multinational industrial, energy, logistics and infrastructure employers seeking senior leadership across Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or Country Operations. I am open to Bangkok, Chonburi, Rayong and wider regional mandates.

I have attached an RGF Thailand-focused executive CV and would value consideration by your senior consultants for suitable international leadership searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
